nodes.label: Overnight Build Report
nodes.rationale: A0–A9 and B1–B7 all complete with 200 passing tests (81 acquisition, 113 analysis, 6 shared) requiring zero hardware, GPU, DeepLabCut or network. Unattended-run discipline was kept even though the run was interactive, because it produces an auditable, resumable trail either way.

nodes.label: B4/B6/B7 Checkpoint Ordering Gap
nodes.rationale: Kinematics (B4) is checkpointed before infer (B7) but structurally depends on stage 7's pose output, and B6 wires per-stage CLI commands in between — so at no point in the prescribed build order can `python -m pipeline kinematics` have real or placeholder input data to read.

nodes.label: acquisition/acquisition/ Package Naming Collision
nodes.rationale: acquisition/CLAUDE.md's project structure names the capture-internals package `acquisition/`, which nested inside the monorepo's own acquisition app directory reads as acquisition/acquisition/camera_backend.py. Kept exactly as specified rather than guessing at a rename; the block was probably written for a standalone single-purpose repo.
